admission: initial is the original first-window cutoff; always bypasses only that cutoff. Both enabled arms use identical weak retention, ownership and runtime bytes.
counterInterpretation: collectedMisses counts cleared occupied slots before key comparison, not necessarily additional same-key source calls. Occupancy at close is not a count of live weak referents. Always mode may grow under unchanged cumulative hit/collision rules; this is not a fixed-capacity ablation.
decision: Descriptive cutoff-only ablation; no significance claim or production-promotion gate.
estimator: Six same-round ratios of per-JVM medians of all five measured queries, per fixture.
fixtureOrderingBasis: Chosen before timing, using design alone. For three fixtures, all six fixture permutations place each fixture in each position twice; the fixed assignment to the six arm permutations minimizes repeated joint position cells. Other finite fixture counts alternate their declared forward and reverse order.
gcScope: Whole-JVM natural GC log, including setup and warmups. Ordered wrappers retain Values; this cohort does not isolate weak collection or useful-key rematerialization.

memoryScope: Ledger peak is the process-authority accounting peak, not a separate query-ledger peak or total retained heap. Weak metadata reservations are reported independently.
pooling: Fresh controls only. No historical, diagnostic, warmup or incomplete-cohort pooling.
routing: Observed query routes and adjacency signatures must agree across all arms and all six rounds of each fixture, for each corresponding warmup/measurement ordinal.
secondaryEstimator: Prespecified sensitivity: same-round ratios of per-JVM arithmetic means of the same five measured queries. Never replaces the primary estimator.
